players.product: compression molding systems for HBM/advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 23,449,896 thousand (-14.4%), operating income JPY 2,493,577 thousand (-52.6%), ordinary income JPY 2,394 million (-54.2%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,849 million (-51.7%). Management states weak demand for consumer products and memory semiconductors plus the impact of US tariff policy depressed orders from the second half of the prior year, so first-quarter sales fell sharply; in the second quarter semiconductor capex gradually recovered, mainly in China, Taiwan and other Asia, and orders and sales turned upward, while profits beat the initial forecast because the sales share of its proprietary compression molding equipment and molds exceeded assumptions and the product mix improved. Operating income bridge: lower sales -JPY 1,859 million, product mix -JPY 312 million, write-downs -JPY 351 million, higher SG&A -JPY 246 million.

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, first half (semi-annual report): Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment net sales JPY 21,585,649 thousand (-14.7%), down mainly in China, Korea and other Asia as customers held back capex from the second half of the prior year; operating income JPY 2,350 million (-53.6%). Medical Device net sales JPY 1,224 million (+8.4%), operating income JPY 225 million (-6.3%). Laser Processing Equipment net sales JPY 640 million (-33.0%) as customers kept postponing capex for its main laser trimmer products, operating loss JPY 82 million (prior-year operating loss JPY 41 million). H1 R&D JPY 409 million (Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment JPY 358 million, Laser JPY 50 million). In the semiconductor equipment business the company set up TOWA Malaysia Sales & Services (Kuala Lumpur, April 17, 2025), TOWA Semiconductor India (Gurgaon, April 26, 2025) and a new sub-subsidiary in Guangdong Province, China (Shenzhen, August 11, 2025).
